simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בַּיִת (H1006) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בַּיִת (Bayith) means Bajith , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Isa 15 2.

definitions.full: H1006. Bayith בַּ֫יִת with article הַבַּיִת Isa 15:2 according to Ew Brd Di and others proper name, of a location but abbreviated; perhaps for דִּבְלָתַיִם בֵּית Jer 48:22 (so Ew and others) or בָּמוֺת בֵּית compare MI 27 (compare De Di); others (Ges De Che Or) take ׳הַבּ here = the house , i.e. temple or shrine.
